label: plan12.14-task4-qualification
authorization: operator, Claude chat 2026-11-26: "Release it" (one zero-paid qualification run on the index Redis p1214-index-test-redis with its volume, ports 6401/8781, 1,024 MiB and the shared embedding cache; no paid call is possible)
capacity: two live index lines at a time (_rotate drops the previous line once the next is indexed); the largest snapshot holds 34,812 records, so about 70,000 at most, under G2's five-line 96,763 at the same 1,024 MiB
models: none: the index Gateway's upstream is unroutable (127.0.0.1:9); the keyring is the in-process stand-in of m1_scale._provision, so no OS keyring write
teardown: run_qualification closes the client, stops the index Gateway and removes the container and volume in a finally block
order: the four historical sets first, each on its own, then the fresh set; a historical set that fails its gates stops the run with the fresh set unopened; the report records the opening before the fresh fixture is read, and an opened report (at this pinned output only) refuses a second run; every finished tree is written at once (m2b_evaluate.run_qualification)
estimate: 56 cutoff trees (13 fresh, 43 replay) at the shared embedding cache's 63-134 s per tree in G2 and the budget pass, plus new vectors for the 54 snapshots the cache has not seen (about 0.13-0.17 s per new record cold): about 2-3.5 hours (Fable 5.2 review)
